edits.before: Karma wins level 1 outright: her empowered Q (Mantra-boosted Inner Flame at level 1 is unavailable, but her base RQ once she hits it) plus range means she pokes you for free while you have no way to punish. Open Blue Card for mana so you can farm through the harassment and never walk up to auto her behind her shield. There is no all-in threat you can present pre-6, so just soak experience and CS under tower. Accept that you lose the level-1 poke exchange and play for your spike.
edits.after: Karma wins level 1 outright: Mantra is usable at level 1 with no skill point, so an empowered RQ Inner Flame can chunk you immediately, and her 950 range means the poke is free while you have no way to punish. Open Blue Card for mana so you can farm through the harassment and never walk up to auto her behind her shield. There is no all-in threat you can present pre-6, so just soak experience and CS under tower. Accept that you lose the level-1 poke exchange and play for your spike.

notes: Packet defect claims the chart contradicts the 54.3% TF win rate, but content, packet chart and the whys all agree on the Karma-leaning chart (TF wins via map play, not lane stages) — I aligned the full layer to content/packet rather than inventing TF-favored rows; win[] needed no edits (already correct, no-ops avoided). suspectNames 'Gold Card' in spikes[0] is a false positive (real TF W card). needs-antiheal: her heal is only on Mantra-W and minor; existing tether-break advice covers it — flagging rather than forcing an anti-heal item line.
